# A slice of a node_timing trace (fcn_node --trace-file) of a node with bug 011's fix, kept
# by the verification of that fix: the socketcan flood run of a rehearsal
# (bench/node_timing.py --no-build --seconds 24 --downloads 1 --control-seconds 12) on the
# laptop on battery, which the bench of that time refused. The count stood at 3198 from
# 3197.1 ms to 3199.2 ms (after the first base); then the trace saw 3199 to 3202 within
# 0.24 ms, the count two ahead of the grid, and the sensor job waiting for tick 3202 was
